blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Department of Education (DepEd) has released P113 million, representing half of the P226-million allocation for the construction of school buildings in 14 public schools in this city, Calapan City Mayor Doy Leachon said Tuesday. Leachon said the initial funding would allow the city to begin implementing the national school building projects, with the remaining P113 million to be released to fund their completion. The projects include constructing two-story school buildings to address the need for additional classrooms in 14 Calapan schools.
